name: mdrv_presign_upload
description: Step 1 of an upload. Reserves a file and returns { upload_url, s3_key }: `upload_url` is a short-lived presigned PUT URL you (or a client that can PUT raw bytes) send the file's bytes to DIRECTLY (HTTP PUT, no auth header, Content-Type = the file's type). `name` is required; `content_type` defaults to application/octet-stream; `folder_id` is the destination folder UUID (omit for the drive root). After the PUT succeeds, call mdrv_confirm_upload with the returned `s3_key`. Requires the write scope.

folder_id.description: Destination folder UUID; omit for the drive root.
